description: This file defines the ConsulClusteringProviderBuilder class in C#, implementing provider builder interfaces for both silo and client builders within the Orleans framework. It registers the provider with certain attributes and configures clustering options to use Consul based on configuration sections.

classes.name: ConsulClusteringProviderBuilder
classes.description: Sealed internal class that implements provider builder interfaces for both silo and client builders, configuring them to use Consul clustering.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the ISiloBuilder with Consul silo clustering options, binding configuration sections.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the IClientBuilder with Consul client clustering options, binding configuration sections.
